messages.content: Hi, it's your weekly Northline Care check-in. How are you feeling this week? If you have a reading to share — blood pressure or blood sugar — go ahead and send it over.
Blood pressure was 138 over 84 this morning. Honestly haven't talked to a real person in five days. Snow came through Monday and nobody's been out this way since.

Logging that reading — 138/84, got it. And I hear you. Five days is a long stretch of quiet. I'm just an automated check-in line, so I can't keep you company the way a person could — I wish I could do more there. But I'm glad you picked up.
Yeah I figured. I just needed somewhere to put it I guess. Did you need anything about my metformin?
Yes, please — did you take it as prescribed this week?
Mostly. I slept through breakfast on Thursday so I skipped that one. Rest of the week was fine.
Logged — one missed dose Thursday, otherwise on track. Your care team will see that in your notes. Next check-in is set for 7 days out. Stay warm, and I hope the roads open up for you soon.

theme: lonely, just wanted to talk, nobody has been by since the snow
